items.text: Radwater now deals significant damage to full kits with a new scaling system that reduces rad amounts via scaled protection.
Bear rug and regular rug comfort values increased: 100% comfort within 2 m (bear) / 1 m (rug) with gradual falloff, fixing previous 25% solo comfort.
Flashlight weapon now toggles on/off with right‑click like a torch; press F removed. Updated animations and tooltips.
Rabbits added with animation, model, and prefab files.
SteamFriendsList.Refresh optimized, eliminating large lag spikes when authorizing friends to turrets and other structures.
Helicopter, Bradley, and satellite crash‑site crates now save correctly across server restarts; crate despawn time reduced to 30 minutes; heli crates no longer land on unloadable train wagons.
Hackable crates receive proper flag and visual fixes; puzzlereset alerts suppressed after forced restart.
Blocker protection and HP adjusted at Launch Site, Military Tunnels, and Missile Silo for better balance.
Low‑resolution navmesh on ghost ships fixed.
Old AI no longer flee when player jumps.
Session modal overflow fixed; description scroll works and disconnect button remains accessible.
Shop opening no longer invalidates sprites; dynamic fullscreen and gallery sprites now render correctly in store UI.
Modular car wheels corrected: left wheels use proper model, mirrored wheels fixed, normals corrected, leftover rotations cleared.
TC loot panel now shows current group tax when hovering over upkeep cost.
Fixed missing cover images on shop tiles by ensuring coverImage is enabled after initEmpty.
Restored DLC prefab setup, eliminating null reference errors when clicking DLC tiles.
Renamed a field so StoreBundleTool can locate the replicated reference, fixing clicks on featured store tiles.
Revived dynamic shop assets: added cache/uncache logic, made store DLC items use dynamic references, and changed store logic to create empty tiles on warm‑up then fill them when opened.
Semi‑automatic pistol now has stronger damage falloff at range and its high‑quality material craft cost increased from 4 to 6.
Improved car handling: reduced body roll, prevented spin‑outs, enabled higher‑speed drifting, and smoothed steering aggressiveness.
Set up HAB armour colliders for both client and server, added a collision mesh for the frame and updated the prefab.
Configured attack‑heli armour damage colliders and visual toggle groups, adding unique "Col" prefixes to collider names.
Created SellAnimals and AnimalSalePreview dialogue panels to list nearby sellable animals and preview rewards.
Hooked up sale information into the in‑game UI for animal trading.
Cargo ship event now saves and loads correctly: crate positions and loot round progress are persisted across server restarts, preventing despawning and overlapping spawns.
Added HealthThresholdToggle component with list support and subsequent improvements, enabling health‑based effect toggling.
Increased SMG body spawn chance slightly and decreased Rifle body spawn chance, improving mid‑game weapon availability.
Radwater now scales damage based on protection instead of flat values, increasing its threat to fully equipped kits.
Weapon balance updates: semi‑automatic pistol damage falloff increased and craft cost raised; SMG body spawn chance increased while Rifle body spawn chance decreased.
Bear rugs provide full comfort within 2 m (falloff to 3 m) and regular rugs within 1 m (falloff to 2 m), fixing previous low solo comfort values.
Various UI improvements: session modal description scroll works again with overflow clamped, and shop UI sprites remain valid and fully clickable for all tiles.
Flashlight toggles on/off with right‑click, replacing the removed press‑F toggle.
Modular car fixes: wheel mirroring corrected and handling refined (reduced body roll, prevented spin‑outs, smoother steering for high‑speed drifting).
HAB armor collider for attack helicopters fixed, ensuring proper removal and collision handling.
Low‑resolution navmesh on ghost ships repaired, improving AI pathing.
Old AI units no longer flee when the player jumps.

Crash‑site crates (helicopter, Bradley, satellite) now persist across server restarts with a 30 min despawn timer; heli crates no longer land on unloadable train wagons. Hackable crate flags and visuals fixed, and cargo ship event crates now save/load correctly, preventing duplicate spawns.

Group tax is displayed when hovering over upkeep cost in the TC loot panel; animal trading UI now includes SellAnimals and AnimalSalePreview panels showing nearby sellable animals and expected rewards.

Store system enhancements: dynamic shop assets restored with UI caching, dynamic references for items, warm‑up tile creation, DynamicPagePrefab added to store takeover, and HealthThresholdToggle introduced for health‑based behavior configuration.

2026-08-25.summary:
### Combat & Damage
- Radwater now scales damage based on protection instead of flat values, increasing its threat to fully equipped kits.
- Weapon balance updates: semi‑automatic pistol damage falloff increased and craft cost raised; SMG body spawn chance increased while Rifle body spawn chance decreased.

### Comfort & UI
- Bear rugs provide full comfort within 2 m (falloff to 3 m) and regular rugs within 1 m (falloff to 2 m), fixing previous low solo comfort values.
- Various UI improvements: session modal description scroll works again with overflow clamped, and shop UI sprites remain valid and fully clickable for all tiles.

### Tools & Vehicles
- Flashlight toggles on/off with right‑click, replacing the removed press‑F toggle.
- Modular car fixes: wheel mirroring corrected and handling refined (reduced body roll, prevented spin‑outs, smoother steering for high‑speed drifting).
- HAB armor collider for attack helicopters fixed, ensuring proper removal and collision handling.

### AI & Navigation
- Low‑resolution navmesh on ghost ships repaired, improving AI pathing.
- Old AI units no longer flee when the player jumps.

### Events & Persistence
- Crash‑site crates (helicopter, Bradley, satellite) now persist across server restarts with a 30 min despawn timer; heli crates no longer land on unloadable train wagons. Hackable crate flags and visuals fixed, and cargo ship event crates now save/load correctly, preventing duplicate spawns.

### Economy & Trading
- Group tax is displayed when hovering over upkeep cost in the TC loot panel; animal trading UI now includes SellAnimals and AnimalSalePreview panels showing nearby sellable animals and expected rewards.
- Store system enhancements: dynamic shop assets restored with UI caching, dynamic references for items, warm‑up tile creation, DynamicPagePrefab added to store takeover, and HealthThresholdToggle introduced for health‑based behavior configuration.

items.text: Medkits now reduce radiation by 20, and longsword swings have a larger 0.4 radius with a faster 1.5‑second delay for more accurate attacks.
SAM sites fire proximity‑fuse missiles at drones, target 2.25× faster, can destroy drone‑dropped explosives mid‑air, and a new setting lets servers adjust the drone detonation distance.
Homing launchers now show a “Keep on target” label and their lock‑on timer is 30 % shorter.

2026-08-24.summary:
### Combat & Weapons
- Medkits now reduce radiation by 20, and longsword swings have a larger 0.4 radius with a faster 1.5‑second delay for more accurate attacks.
- SAM sites fire proximity‑fuse missiles at drones, target 2.25× faster, can destroy drone‑dropped explosives mid‑air, and a new setting lets servers adjust the drone detonation distance.
- Homing launchers now show a “Keep on target” label and their lock‑on timer is 30 % shorter.
